hero_title.en: Fuel Academic Excellence with Real-World Media Intelligence

hero_description.en: Give your students and faculty access to the same datasets by the Media Techology Monitor (MTM) that media experts, industry regulators and scholars have relied on for over two decades. Nationally representative, bilingual, and rigorous enough for peer review.

Topics and variables gallery using resea.key: Topics and variables gallery using research questions - Emphasize discovery and research

dataset_title.en: Multiple datasets. Hundreds of research directions.

dataset_description.en: MTM tracks how Canadians consume media and technology across 5000+ variables — spanning platforms, behaviours, demographics, and devices. Browse by topic to find what your research needs.

topic_1_example_question.en: What share of Canadians watched a live sporting event online last month?

topic_1_variables.en: Watched sports online, Sports, SVOD, ESPN+, TSN

topic_2_example_question.en: How does Twitch viewership differ between Teens and Gen Z Canadians?

topic_3_example_question.en: How rapidly has AI tool adoption grown among Canadians since 2023?

topic_3_variables.en: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Age 18 to 24, Grok

topic_4_example_question.en: How does gaming device ownership vary across income levels in Canada?

topic_4_variables.en: Game console owners, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, XBox, Income

topic_5_example_question.en: How do media consumption patterns differ between English- and French-speaking Canadians?

topic_5_variables.en: Anglophone, Francophone, Social Media, Language spoken at Home, News, TV hours

topic_6_example_question.en: Are younger Canadians abandoning traditional news formats in favour of social media?

topic_6_variables.en: Read online news, News consumption platform, Social media, CTV, YouTube

dataset_footer.en: Over 5000+ variables available across 200+ topic areas, searchable and filterable in our tools.

workflow_title.en: Gold standard research in media and technology for all of your research needs

workflow_description.en: We provide universities and colleges with the insights needed to drive innovation and learning across every specialization and at every stage of their academic journey.

workflow_step_1_description.en: Ground assignments in the most up-to-date research and build market-ready skills by navigating the same metrics and trends used by Canada’s top media companies, ad agencies, media associations and governmental institutions.

workflow_step_2_description.en: Enhance your curriculum with authentic, up-to-date reports and datasets that turn abstract concepts into tangible lessons.

workflow_step_3_description.en: Support your research in the country's most robust longitudinal media studies, ensuring your findings are both current and credible.

testimonial_title.en: What academic institutions are saying about us

testimonial_quote.en: Our decisions have to stand up to scrutiny — from where funding goes to how impact is measured. MTM's data gives us that credibility. It connects audience behaviour to real outcomes, helping us plan investments and policies that actually reflect how Canadians consume media today.
